title: Knowledge Entry profile — salesforce.email-template v1
description: typeFacts carry the collector's extraction faithfully: an adapter passes every fact through except a documented exclusion, so a fact the profile does not declare fails validation loudly instead of vanishing from the entry. Component identity is Folder/Name — the exact format workflow alerts, approval processes, and routing rules reference. The meta-derived facts (templateType, subject, encoding, letterhead, relatedEntityType, available) are absent entirely when the sibling -meta.xml is missing, so only folder is required. Template bodies are free text: every edge is regex-derived and carries the heuristic marker.

subject.description: Sanitized subject line (sanitize_literal: no credentials, emails, IPs, URL paths).
